findings.highlight: I can pull out the nail in my right arm!
findings.evidenceJa: なら、右手に刺さった釘を抜けば！
findings.governingReading: Shirou begins a conditional plan: then, if he can pull out the stake embedded in his right arm—
findings.explanation: The English turns the interrupted conditional into a confident statement of ability and again renders the weapon as a nail.

findings.highlight: thrusts out her nail to pierce my left hand as well!
findings.evidenceJa: 左手までも鎖で縛ろうと釘を突き出してくる！
findings.governingReading: Rider thrusts another stake in order to bind even Shirou’s left hand with her chain.
findings.explanation: The English replaces the intended chain restraint with piercing as the sole objective, changing Rider’s trap mechanics.

findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントの“釘”は、容赦なく俺の目へ突き出され
findings.governingReading: Rider mercilessly thrusts the stake directly at Shirou’s eye.
findings.explanation: The English drops the eye target entirely from this alternate occurrence.

findings.highlight: And she is shot from the side by numerous bright bullets.
findings.evidenceJa: 横合いから放たれた、無数の光弾の前に弾かれていた。
findings.governingReading: Countless light projectiles from the side knock Rider’s stake away.
findings.explanation: As in the parallel branch, the English makes Rider herself the target rather than the stake being deflected.

findings.highlight: I hit my butt on the ground.
findings.evidenceJa: どん、と容赦なく地面に尻餅をつく事になった。
findings.governingReading: Shirou again lands butt-first with a heavy, merciless impact.
findings.explanation: The repeated English occurrence again removes the thud and violent force while retaining only the comic posture.

findings.highlight: The Servant in black turns her back.
findings.evidenceJa: 黒いサーヴァントが身を翻す。
findings.governingReading: Rider swiftly pivots or wheels her body around.
findings.explanation: “Turns her back” specifies an exposed orientation and loses the swift whole-body reversal.

findings.highlight: I throw away my weapon and reach for my right arm with my free left hand.
findings.evidenceJa: 剣を捨て、唯一自由になる左手を右腕の釘へと伸ばす。
findings.governingReading: Shirou discards his sword and reaches his only free hand, the left, toward the stake embedded in his right arm.
findings.explanation: The English generalizes sword to weapon and makes the damaged arm itself the reach target, omitting the embedded stake he intends to pull free.
